algorithm: iMPC (iLQR-style trajectory optimizer over a locally-smoothed convex quasi-dynamic contact model, CQDC) for local case studies; an RRT variant (RRT-through-contact) using a smoothed Mahalanobis distance metric, single-step dynamically-consistent extension, and contact sampling for global planning on harder tasks
hand: Allegro Hand (full 3D model, in-hand rotation / pen placement / plate pickup / door opening); a 2-DoF-per-finger planar hand (2 fingers) for 2D reorientation tasks
arm: 2 Kuka iiwa arms for the real-hardware IiwaBimanual bucket-rotation task; Allegro Hand tasks are fixed-base with no arm
sim: Custom Convex Quasi-Dynamic Differentiable Contact (CQDC) model implemented in Drake (MultibodyPlant/SceneGraph), validated against Drake's own high-fidelity second-order contact solver
headline_metric: RRT planner wall-clock running time (1000 iterations, Table III)
headline_value: analytic smoothing fastest across all 6 systems tested, e.g. 3.25 s (PlanarPushing) up to 117.16 s (AllegroPlate)
note_gaps: The exact quadratic tracking-cost weights for iMPC (Sec. V-A) and the precise form of the SOCP objective's Q matrix (Eq. 27a) render blank in the parsed paper and are not fully recoverable from the parsed code beyond Kp (joint stiffness) and unactuated_mass_scale. contact_detection_tolerance for the planar_hand_ball* config family is anomalously 10.0 with units/scale unexplained. No discrete real-robot trial count or success percentage is reported, only continuous position/orientation error metrics.
